newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-KARANKA SET TO JOIN REAL MADRID.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-KARANKA SET TO JOIN REAL MADRID.

text.p: Aitor Karanka, one of Spain's most promising defenders, is expected to join Real Madrid, Spanish newspapers reported on Wednesday.
Karanka, 23, has played for Athletic Bilbao since he was a teenager, working his way through their youth system. He has made one appearance for Spain -- against Armenia in April 1995.
The move will fill the hole in Real Madrid's central defence that has existed since international defender Rafael Alkorta moved to Athletic Bilbao in June.
